title: Hugo site configuration
description: The site's hugo.toml (or .yaml, .json). Hugo reads many more keys than these, so other keys are allowed; these are the ones an edit usually touches.

baseURL.description: The address the site is served at, ending in /.

languageCode.description: The site language as a tag such as en-US or fa-IR.

defaultContentLanguage.description: The language of content files with no language in their name.

theme.description: The theme or themes the site uses, by folder or module path.

params.description: The theme's and the site's own settings, read in templates as site.Params.

menus.description: Menus defined in the configuration instead of in front matter.

languages.description: One entry per language: its name, weight, direction, and settings.

module.description: Hugo modules: imports (such as the Slipway adapter), mounts, and replacements.

outputs.description: The output formats per page kind; the Slipway adapter needs sourcemap on home and markdown on pages.

disableKinds.description: Page kinds Hugo does not build, such as taxonomy or RSS.
